items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: I can see Peter Lawford and you know and Bonita Granville and all those people, you know in the costumes, the sweaters.

ctx.x: To help keep the music happening. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -15-

Yeah, he believes in it. He puts his money where his mouth is. I like that. And it’s nice that this school, I mean I didn’t know about this school before I came up here the first time. And it’s like an MGM idea of what a college should look like, it really is. I mean I can see Peter Lawford and you know and Bonita Granville and all those people, you know in the costumes, the sweaters. Lana Turner as a teenager, I can see it here. And of course the weather this weekend has been incredible. I said, “Fillius, you…
He does. All places he has friends.
